catalog_quirks.body: Plugsky Free includes Micro and Lite chat/JSON aliases without a card. Free trials were retired in November 2026. Shared fair-use rate limits apply, not a separate monthly credit grant per model. Backing models may change or fail over; streaming can identify the underlying upstream. Chat, JSON mode and streaming were tested October 8, 2026; funding terms rechecked November 7, 2026. Tools and vision remain disabled without Free-plan route-specific verification. Image generation is paid-only. https://plugsky.com/docs
